Let P(n) be the statement \(1+3+\cdots+(2n-1)=n^2\). For \(n=1\), both sides equal \(1\). If P(k) holds, then
\[
1+3+\cdots+(2k-1)+(2(k+1)-1)
=k^2+2k+1=(k+1)^2.
\]
Thus P(k+1) holds. By induction, P(n) holds for every positive integer \(n\).
